notes.title: Maybot Run Beta 0.16a Now Live!
notes.notes:
A quick update adding some new baddies and a new mechanic to level 3.

1) Homeless missile baddy
2) Falling Nukes baddy
3) Rising bombs baddy

4) The mechanic is a button which when trodden on by the player causes something to happen. For example a missile to shoot at Maybot, or lots of collectables, tax, and votes to fall from the sky, or all the bombs in the area to change position either making new paths available or making things trickier.

5) Made some minor fixes.

Enjoy :)

notes.title: Maybot Run beta 0.15 now live!
notes.notes:
We've uploaded our latest Maybot Run beta build 0.15. We've taken loads of feedback into account and fixed quite a few bugs here are the main changes and fixes:

1) Leader-board system that works
2) Changed graphics of bombs and added numerous kinds
3) added more backgrounds and enemies
4) Revamped level 1 and level 2 (level 3 revamp to come soon)
5) Fixed pause causing crash under certain conditions
6) Added option to turn off starting RUN! scream
7) Tutorial on off there from beginning now not after completing tutorial
8) Modified starting game speed and made daily speed increments slightly less
9) Added more quotes to loading screen (64 total now from the original 32)
10) darkened the background slightly to make the player standout slightly more

Thanks to everyone testing, videoing, and just generally playing the game. You're feedback has really helped us. We'll continue to improve the game until the release on 19th October 2017.

Things we will add before release:
1) 2 more music tracks by Electric Fan Death for levels 2 and 3
2) Some more new baddies
3) The final unlockable character
4) Another piece of artwork
5) More Sound FX

All the best and happy gaming

Bloodline Games

notes.title: Quick update to Maybot Run beta 0.12a, now live!
notes.notes:
Very quick update to the beta version of Maybot Run to fix issue 1 below and found a work around for issue 2:

1) Fixed issue where when in the slow mo section the game would freeze when paused and force the player to quit to main menu.

2) Loading the game from the .exe file causes Steam leader-boards and other Steam functions not to work properly. WORK-AROUND: For Steam leader-boards and other functions to work properly you must load the game from the Steam client by pressing the 'Play' button. If you want a desktop shortcut this can be created from the Steam client by right clicking on Maybot Run in your Steam library and choosing 'Create Desktop Shortcut' from the drop down menu. We will try and make the Steam functions work from the .exe but for now this is a good simple work around :) Thank you for your patience :)

Thanks to everyone who's been helping beta test the game :)

notes.title: Maybot Run Beta 0.12 now live
notes.notes:
Maybot Run beta version 0.12 has just gone live. We have addressed a number of issues and added some pretty cool content:

1) The issue where players fall through the ground on starting level 2 or 3 has now been fixed. 
2) More enemy variety has been added to the first level. 
3) The problem where when you pause in a slowed down tutorial section the game never speeds back up has been fixed.
4) More votes and hearts have been added to the first level.
5) A counter has been added in the settings menu to show how many kills of 100 you have got (for monochrome cheat to unlock).
6) Added more backgrounds to L2 and L3.
7) Fixed some of the sound glitches where certain SFX played even when SFX volume was turned down.
8) Fixed issue where volume levels would not save.
9) Difficulty streaming has been improved.
10) Some issues of blurry objects have been addressed.
11) A hidden character not starting with their perk has been fixed.

Thanks for everyone's feedback, Maybot Run is coming along nicely and we should meet the 19th October 2017 release date.
